task_description: Rebuild the DEMAze Technologies marketing site into a modern, immersive, 3D-interactive, production-grade experience. Preserve the proven foundation (TanStack Start SSR, Vite/Lovable wrapper, Tailwind v4, Supabase forms, security headers/CSP, Railway/Nitro deploy, and the honest real content model) and build a new immersive presentation layer on top: an SSR-safe React Three Fiber 3D hero, a smooth-scroll + motion-primitive system, a rebuilt layout shell and section components, and a page-by-page rebuild of all ten routes. Honor prefers-reduced-motion, provide non-WebGL fallbacks, keep WCAG AA and no layout shift. All work on branch rebuild/immersive-3d; the sandbox is INTEGRATIONS_ONLY so new deps cannot be installed and the four CI checks cannot run locally; CI is the authoritative validator.

verification.summary: The four CI checks (typecheck, lint, test, build) CANNOT run in this INTEGRATIONS_ONLY sandbox: the npm registry is unreachable, node_modules has no tool binaries, and npm/node are broken by a missing NODE_OPTIONS preload. They are deferred to CI, which is the authoritative gate. IN-SANDBOX VERIFICATION PERFORMED AND PASSED: (1) SSR safety - three/@react-three/* are statically imported ONLY in src/components/three/hero-scene.tsx (reached via the mount-gated React.lazy dynamic import in client-canvas.tsx); no route or shared layout imports three at module scope. (2) All window/document/matchMedia/IntersectionObserver access in the new modules is inside useEffect bodies or behind typeof guards - none executes at module top-level during SSR. (3) Supabase forms intact - contact-form and playbook-form keep the honeypot `website` field (tabIndex -1) and hidden `startedAt` timestamp wired to submitContact/requestPlaybook; forms.functions.ts and submission-guards.ts untouched. (4) Content model untouched - site-data.ts and its test invariants preserved (services 4, projects >=16, metrics 4, technologies 8, industries >=15). (5) A compile-breaking duplicate-import regression in content-sections.tsx was caught and fixed in FEAT-004. (6) test_quality - the added src/lib/motion.test.ts meaningfully pins the SSR contract of prefersReducedMotion()/supportsWebGL() (both must return false with no window/document) and would fail if those guards were removed; existing content and guard tests were not weakened. BLOCKING ITEM FOR CI GREEN (network-dependent, not fixable in-sandbox): package-lock.json is out of sync (contains none of three/@react-three/*/lenis/@types/three). A maintainer/CI step with network must run `npm install` once to regenerate the lockfile in sync with package.json and commit it BEFORE `npm ci` (and therefore all four CI checks) can pass.
